input.question: What values does the purpose parameter accept for the file upload endpoint (client.files.upload)? Does it include "ocr"?

content.text:
`"ocr"` is a valid, documented value — Mistral's docs use it directly, e.g.:

```python
uploaded_pdf = client.files.upload(
    file={"file_name": "2201.04234v3.pdf", "content": open("2201.04234v3.pdf", "rb")},
    purpose="ocr"
)
```

Sources:
- [OCR Processor — Upload a File](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/document-processing/basic_ocr#ocr-images-and-pdfs)
- [Document QnA — Upload a File](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/document-processing/document_qna#usage)
- [Batch Processing — Prepare Batch](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/batch-processing#prepare-batch-file) (shows `purpose="batch"` for comparison)

So the endpoint itself accepts `fine-tune`, `batch`, and `ocr`. Your type checker error means the installed SDK's type stubs (likely `mistralai` Python/TS client) are out of date and haven't been regenerated with the `ocr` enum value yet — upgrade the `mistralai` package to the latest version, or if it's still missing, cast/ignore the literal type as a temporary workaround.
